<?php
class DynamicNameBox {
    public $slot = 11;
}
function choose_dynamic_name() {
    global $base, $replacement;
    $base = $replacement;
    return 'slot';
}
$base = new DynamicNameBox;
$old = $base;
$replacement = new DynamicNameBox;
$replacement->slot = 22;
echo 'NULLSAFE|', $base?->{choose_dynamic_name()}, '|OLD|', $old->slot,
    '|CURRENT|', $base->slot, '|';
